section.5: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

5.name_native: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Dharr said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: ‘When anyone of you gets up to perform prayer, then indeed mercy is facing him, so he should not smooth the pebbles.’”
